section.title: Brand & Communications
section.purpose: Capture brand promise, voice, claims, languages and communication approvals.

questions.title: Brand promise
questions.prompt: What does the company promise customers in plain language?
questions.recommendation: Use the promise customers actually buy.

questions.title: Reference examples
questions.prompt: Which existing pages, emails, proposals, ads or messages best represent the voice?

questions.title: Forbidden claims
questions.prompt: What claims, guarantees, phrases or comparisons must never be made?

questions.title: Languages
questions.prompt: Which languages must the system understand and produce?
questions.recommendation: Define translation vs native localized writing.

questions.title: Tone by context
questions.prompt: Where should tone change: sales, support, collections, crisis, donor or executive communication?
questions.recommendation: Do not force one tone everywhere.

questions.title: Publishing approval
questions.prompt: Who approves public posts, campaigns, press or website changes?
questions.recommendation: Keep explicit approval until evidence supports broader authority.

questions.title: Brand assets
questions.prompt: Where are logos, fonts, colors, photography, templates and guidelines stored?
